name: Article 14 – 77/2
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 2a. For projects referred to in Annex Ia to this Regulation and where Union legislation refers to this provision pursuant to Article 14(2) of this Regulation, with regard to the environmental assessments and the obligations referred to in Article 4(7) of Directive 2000/60/EC, Article 9(1), point (a), of Directive 2009/147/EC, Articles 6(4) and 16(1) of Directive 92/43/EEC, certain projects developed for strategic sectors or categories shall be considered to be of public interest and may be considered to have an overriding public interest and to serve the interests of public health and safety in individual cases and provided that all the conditions set out in those Directives are fulfilled. When assessing the fulfilment of the conditions referred to in this paragraph, the strategic nature of the project, shall be given specific consideration. In such a case, Member States may restrict, in duly justified and specific circumstances, the application of this paragraph to certain parts of their territory, to certain types of technology or to projects with certain technical characteristics.
